sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 2010
ACT I OF 2010
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010.
An Act further to amend the North-West Frontier
Province Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
[Gazette of N.-W.'F.P. Extraordinary,
18th January, 2010]
No.
PA/N.-W.F.P./Bills/2010/1683, dated 18-1-2010.---The
North West Frontier Province Public Service Commission (Amendment) Bill, 2010
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier Province
on 12-1-2010 and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier
Province on 15th January, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Legislature of the North-West Frontier Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
North-West Frontier Province Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
(N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XI of 1978), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.
